name: EMCURE PHARMACEUTICALS L
summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited provide quality and affordable healthcare solutions worldwide. It offers products in various therapeutic areas, such gynecology, anti-infectives, pain/analgesics, Vitamins, Minerals & Nutrients, blood-related, oncology, respiratory, HIV antivirals, gastro, anti-diabetic, neuro, and cardiovascular. It provides its products under Orofer XT, Tenectase, Pause, Metpure XL, Vylda, Vitanova, and Proxym brand names. Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited has a strategic partnership with Novo Nordisk India Pvt Ltd. for the development and commercialization of Poviztra, a semaglutide injection for weight loss. Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Pune, India.
